name: use-case-diagnostic-genomics-model-execution: attributes.setting
description: Updated for the Hegde et al. 2025 judgements that became active in PR #169, which make a second linked foundation-model study, and for the newly linked withheld and outside-scope studies. Historical releases retain the previous value.

attributes.previous_value: Published execution benchmarks, each on stated inputs: CPU-only GATK, Parabricks on L4, A100 and H100 GPUs and DRAGEN v4.2 on ten germline WGS samples (Samarakoon et al. 2025); two germline and four somatic callers on CPU and 2, 4 and 8 GPU cloud and DGX machines on one HG002 30x genome (O'Connell et al. 2023); Sentieon DNASeq and Parabricks Germline on Google Cloud machines of similar hourly cost, five exomes and five genomes (Franzoso et al. 2025); the DRAGEN 4.2 developer total runtime for HG002, 1,838.5 seconds on one hardware configuration and 5,521.21 seconds on an AWS f1.4xlarge configuration, whose stage times cannot be summed because of concurrency; Parabricks v4.3.0 on V100 and A100 nodes against the CPU GATK equivalent at five read depths of human WGS (Marangoni et al. 2026); three Sentieon DNAscope pipelines on one Azure instance (Hu et al. 2026); and GenomeOcean inference in BF16 and FP8 on one H100 with microbial genomes (Yu et al. 2026). Two further linked studies, Clair3 and DeepVariant on HG003 long reads (Zheng et al. 2026) and DNA language model inference on one A100 (Aspidova et al. 2026), are withheld pending source concerns. Hardware differs within most comparisons, so differences mix software and hardware.
attributes.value: Published execution benchmarks, each on stated inputs: CPU-only GATK, Parabricks on L4, A100 and H100 GPUs and DRAGEN v4.2 on ten germline WGS samples (Samarakoon et al. 2025); two germline and four somatic callers on CPU and 2, 4 and 8 GPU cloud and DGX machines on one HG002 30x genome (O'Connell et al. 2023); Sentieon DNASeq and Parabricks Germline on Google Cloud machines of similar hourly cost, five exomes and five genomes (Franzoso et al. 2025); the DRAGEN 4.2 developer total runtime for HG002, 1,838.5 seconds on one hardware configuration and 5,521.21 seconds on an AWS f1.4xlarge configuration, whose stage times cannot be summed because of concurrency; Parabricks v4.3.0 on V100 and A100 nodes against the CPU GATK equivalent at five read depths of human WGS (Marangoni et al. 2026); three Sentieon DNAscope pipelines on one Azure instance (Hu et al. 2026); GenomeOcean inference in BF16 and FP8 on one H100 with microbial genomes (Yu et al. 2026); and LoRA fine-tuning and test-set scoring time of Nucleotide Transformer 500M on 2 × TITAN Xp, and fine-tuning time of pruned DNABERT-2 on 2 × Quadro RTX 8000, on a human eQTL variant classification task (Hegde et al. 2025). Four further linked studies are withheld pending source concerns: Clair3 and DeepVariant on HG003 long reads (Zheng et al. 2026), DNA language model inference on one A100 (Aspidova et al. 2026), Evo 2 embedding extraction for all ClinVar variants (Pearce et al. 2026) and Nucleotide Transformer IA3 fine-tuning time (Dalla-Torre et al. 2025). Pretraining compute for NTv3 and HyenaDNA is linked as outside scope. Hardware differs within most comparisons, so differences mix software and hardware.
